## Why

Using an AI tool is a signal. Shipping a file that contains AI work is the win. We currently measure the signal and not the win, and the few numbers we do have describe ourselves.

Measured 25 Aug 2026 in [PROD] Slate, last 90 days:

|  | Total | Users |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `wcs_ai_tool_applied` | 116 | 19 |
| `wcs_export` | 260,096 | 1,906 |

Applies by tool: `remove-background-bria` 94, `godrays` 13, `studio-lighting` 6, `relight` 3, `remove-logo` 0.

The events themselves are fine. They fire, they arrive, and their properties are correct — verified directly against Amplitude, not inferred from the code. The volume is small because the tools are deliberately held to internal accounts until GA. Nineteen of those users are us.

## The shape of this work

GA is the hinge. Before it, everything that can be proved or prepared without an audience. After it, the analysis that only becomes possible once the gating changes.

Doing the preparation now means GA starts with instrumentation already trusted, instead of a month spent debugging telemetry while the numbers finally matter.

## Children

1. Declare the five AI events in the tracking plan
2. Dashboard: tool performance — time per job and failure
3. Dashboard: iteration and adoption
4. Dashboard: AI share of exports (post-GA)

[WEB-3199](https://linear.app/slateteams/issue/WEB-3199/we-cant-tell-whether-an-ai-edit-actually-made-it-into-the-export) is the code change the fourth one depends on: it stamps AI provenance onto `wcs_export` so the headline metric becomes computable at all. It is open and stacked behind the Remove Logo PR.

## Two things everyone reading these dashboards needs to know

Filter `is_demo = false` on every chart. Demo projects are seeded content.

A pre-GA baseline is staff behaviour, not customer behaviour. Do not carry one across the GA line as a comparison.

## Worth agreeing before GA, not after

What an acceptable AI-assisted export rate actually looks like. A number chosen after seeing the first week tends to be the number the first week produced.
